title: Second-order effective renormalized Hamiltonian of Quantum Chromodynamics
summary: The effective Hamiltonian of quantum chromodynamics in the front form of Hamiltonian dynamics is calculated and renormalized. The renormalization group procedure for effective particles up to the second order in the coupling constant is used. Small gluon mass is used to regulate infrared singularities of the theory. The counterterms necessary to renormalize the theory are determined by computing matrix elements of the effective Hamiltonian.
